item.title: Delhi HC rejects Parle Products plea in ‘20-20’ trademark case against Avon Agro Industries
item.description: New Delhi: The Delhi High Court has dismissed an appeal filed by Parle Products in a trademark dispute over the mark “20-20”, upholding the decision of the Registrar of Trade Marks to grant registration of the mark to Avon Agro Industries. According to news reports, Justice Tushar Rao Gedela ruled that Parle’s later commercial use of the mark could not override Avon Agro’s earlier trademark application. item.title: Audi to raise car prices in India by up to 2% from April 1
item.description: New Delhi: Audi has announced that it will increase the prices of its vehicles in India by up to 2% from April 1, 2026. According to the company, the price revision will apply across its entire model range and will affect the ex-showroom prices of its vehicles. The German luxury carmaker said the adjustment comes in response to rising input costs and the impact of currency fluctuations. item.title: CCI dismisses complaint against BookMyShow over alleged abuse of dominance
item.description: New Delhi: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) has dismissed a complaint filed against BookMyShow’s parent company Big Tree Entertainment, which alleged abuse of dominant position in the online movie ticketing market. According to the complaint, BookMyShow had entered into exclusive arrangements with cinema operators that allegedly prevented them from partnering with competing online ticketing platforms. item.title: Sun TV hikes DTH bouquet prices; tightens compliance framework
item.description: New Delhi: Sun TV Network announced a hike in prices of its bouquets in its new Reference Interconnect Offer (RIO) effective May 1, 2026, while leaving the composition of the bouquets, the genre classification of channels and the visible a-la-carte rates of its core SD channels unchanged. item.title: New York Festivals Advertising Awards names Will Dempster as Film Craft Executive Jury chair
item.description: New Delhi: New York Festivals has announced the Film Craft Executive Jury for the 2026 edition of the New York Festivals Advertising Awards, with Will Dempster appointed as jury chair. Dempster is partner and head of production at Mischief and co-founder of The Candy Factory. item.title: Publicis Groupe acquires AdgeAI to expand AI-driven creative measurement capabilities
item.description: New Delhi: Publicis Groupe has announced the acquisition of measurement and content intelligence company AdgeAI, as the advertising group expands its capabilities in AI-driven creative measurement and analytics. The Paris-headquartered group said AdgeAI’s platform analyses engagement and conversion data to evaluate the performance of creative and video content.
